title: 基于超图支配集的单文档抽取式摘要方法
summary: 该研究提出一种新颖的单文档抽取式摘要方法，利用超图的支配性质生成摘要。将句子作为节点、关键词或命名实体作为超边构建句子超图，再用贪心算法求支配集以选取摘要句子，并与现有基于图的方法进行性能对比。
summary_en: This study proposes a novel extractive summarization method for single documents using the domination property of hypergraphs. Sentences are nodes and keywords or named entities form hyperedges; a greedy algorithm finds the dominating set to select summary sentences, with performance compared against state-of-the-art graph-based methods.
